title: Faculty & Graduates at 1966 University Ceremony, Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of faculty members or doctoral graduates in academic gowns, hoods, and mortarboards march in a formal procession during a university commencement ceremony. In the midground, a large seated audience watches the outdoor ceremony near landscaped trees, set against the backdrop of an expansive modern high-rise campus building. Developed in March 1966, this square-format snapshot reflects the formal traditions and architectural boom characteristic of American higher education institutions during the mid-1960s.
